text:
Several Russian military aircraft briefly entered South Korea's air defense identification zone (KADIZ) early Tuesday, prompting the Air Force to deploy fighter jets in response, Seoul's Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) said.
The South Korean military detected the Russian aircraft before they entered the KADIZ and deployed fighter jets to prepare for any possible contingencies, the JCS said in a statement.
The aircraft later exited the zone without violating South Korea's airspace, it added.
The air defense zone is not territorial airspace but is delineated to call on foreign planes to identify themselves so as to prevent accidental clashes.
